facebookresearch_fairscale/fairscale/exp.build_slowmo_ddp_wrapper: build a SlowMoDistributedDataParallel wrapper around a PyTorch module for multi-node distributed training with SlowMo momentum

facebookresearch_fairscale/fairscale/exp.run_pushpull_mix: run a PushPull mix step to perform doubly-stochastic consensus averaging across peers

facebookresearch_fairscale/fairscale/exp.create_bipartite_graph: create a DynamicBipartiteExponentialGraph to build a bipartite graph for alternating peer communication
facebookresearch_fairscale/fairscale/exp.get_peers_and_edges: get the out-peers and in-peers for a rank using GraphManager get_peers or get_edges methods
